title: Robust CurveMoE: Multi-Norm Adversarial Defense for Mixture-of-Experts Models via Mode Connectivity
abstract: arXiv:2608.26043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-norm adversarial defense aims to protect neural networks against perturbations defined by different norm constraints, but existing methods typically optimize competing robustness objectives within a single parameter configuration, leading to substantial training cost and unfavorable robustness trade-offs. We propose Robust CurveMoE, an efficient mixture-of-experts framework that connects models specialized for different perturbation norms through a low-loss path and exploits the complementary robustness profiles of models along this path. Robust CurveMoE derives clean and norm-specialized experts from robustness-constrained curve locations and selectively expertizes only influential layers, while sharing the remaining parameters across routing paths. translated_title: 鲁棒曲线专家混合模型：通过模式连通性实现多范数对抗防御的专家混合模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26043v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多范数对抗防御旨在保护神经网络免受由不同范数约束定义的扰动影响，但现有方法通常在单一参数配置下优化相互竞争的鲁棒性目标，导致训练成本高且鲁棒性权衡不佳。我们提出鲁棒曲线专家混合模型（Robust CurveMoE），这是一种高效的专家混合框架，通过低损失路径连接针对不同扰动范数特化的模型，并利用该路径上模型的互补鲁棒性特征。鲁棒曲线专家混合模型从鲁棒性约束的曲线位置派生干净和范数特化的专家，仅选择性专家化有影响力的层，同时共享其余参数跨路由路径。为进一步降低曲线构建成本，我们引入贡献引导的部分更新，利用基于初始化的梯度分数选择有影响力的曲线参数。
tldr: 本文提出Robust CurveMoE，一种通过低损失路径连接不同范数特化模型并利用模式连通性共享参数的高效多范数对抗防御框架，显著降低训练成本并改善鲁棒性权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Robust CurveMoE, an efficient multi-norm adversarial defense framework that connects norm-specialized models via a low-loss path and leverages mode connectivity with parameter sharing, reducing training cost and improving robustness trade-offs.
